qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: North America's largest network of permitted solid waste landfills (>250 active landfills) creates an insurmountable physical moat protected by extreme NIMBYism, stringent EPA environmental permitting, and prohibitive transport economics. WM controls ~25-30% of US landfill capacity. Demonstrated pricing power: core yield increases of 5-7% annually across commercial, industrial, and residential contracts consistently exceed CPI. Tangible ROIC averages ~25% and 5-year median GAAP ROIC is 12.24%. Primary erosion threat is municipal zero-waste mandates or landfill diversion regulations, which WM actively hedges via North America's largest recycling and renewable natural gas (RNG) capture network.

qualitative.evidence: FY2016-FY2025 financial history shows extraordinary operational resilience and cash generation: Sales grew from $13.6B (2016) to $25.2B (2025), EBIT expanded from $2.3B to $4.3B, and Operating Cash Flow doubled from $3.0B to $6.04B. 5-year median GAAP ROIC is 12.24% with operating/tangible ROIC steady at 24.96%. Stericycle acquisition in Nov 2024 added high-barrier medical waste and compliance services; post-acquisition net debt of ~$22.0B is actively being reduced via strong organic Owner FCF ($3.0B+ annually) and suspended share buybacks, maintaining investment-grade interest coverage >6.5x.
